text_en: <moan>
<groan>
The two seem to be breathing...
Your life is forfeit should you wander long about the deep wood.
I daresay you still have much to learn before you might justly claim the title of adventurer. Count yourself lucky we Wood Wailers came when we did.

Is that...[@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000088,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000088,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]? But that would mean... Did you come across a treant!?
Saved by moogles? To even see a moogle in one's lifetime is rare enough, but to be [@1A(1)]saved[@1A(0)] by a [@1A(1)]pack[@1A(0)] of them? Not many can make such a boast.
Did you see the darkened skies? The streaking lights and the falling comets? I know not what to make of it all...
The two outsiders?

If they are outsiders, I imagine they have made for the Adventurers' Guild. But that is just my guess. The Carline Canopy, it's called. To reach it, you need only take this path. You should pay a visit yourself, if you've not yet been.
Welcome to Gridania. You have undergone much to come this far. Passing through the forest when the elementals are angered is no easy thing.
I will delay you no longer. You must be weary. I urge you to visit our Adventurers' Guild, the Carline Canopy. Perhaps you will find some respite there.
Save your japes, or it'll be our limbs they're fetching!
Hit them harder!
Ugh...
Hmph. From that blank look in your eyes, I would guess you are not too well-traveled. Best scuttle over to that corner you were cowering in and go back to sleep.
You speak to me as if I have something to say. Well, I don't, so begone.

You say you heard singing? Well, maybe it was ol' Llymlaen laughin' at us mortals seeking to trespass in her fair demesne. Or maybe it were them silky-voiced sirens the people back in Limsa are a-fearin'. <sigh> Guess some places just ain't meant for an honest man.
Unable to sleep, friend? How about a drink to calm your nerves?
I knew I should have taken an inn room... One more bell amongst this rabble, and the smell alone will do for me.
<sniff> It's heartening to know at least one of you practices proper hygiene.
Then it is set! Once we arrive in Limsa, we shall make our way to the Adventurers' Guild and find us a noble quest! (One that will make us rich, of course! Ahahahah!)
Hm? You say you'd like to join us? I don't know... You don't look like the adventuring type...

Have you decided what endeavors you will undertake once you've arrived in Limsa Lominsa? That is, unless you're on a sort of spiritual journey to become one with your inner self...in which case, I assume you won't be doing much of anything.
Remember, only you can give your life any meaning.
I heard Limsa Lominsa's a filthy cesspool overridden with pirates and pillagers, wenches and wastrels... Heh heh, sounds like my kind of town!
You say you heard a voice singing sweet somethings in your ear now, did you?
Well, I've heard nothing of the sort. Perhaps all this brine has started to pickle your brain.

Rhotano Sea's known for bein' rough with the men who tread on her back. Why, every trip, it seems we lose a few casks to her relentless wrigglin' and writhin'. But worry ye not; I won't be lettin' her make off with our best rum.
A barrel's bounty can't be borne away if it be in me belly!
These seemingly endless sea voyages can truly drain a man's soul of its vim and vigor. Might I offer you a drink to enliven your spirits?
You hear somethin'? 'Cause I hear somethin'. Somethin's goin' on up top. An' that somethin' ain't quite right...
I'd go up an' see myself, but I don't want my adventurin' days endin' before they start! Why don't you see what's afoot?

Pardon me, [@IF($E9(4),milady,sir)], but have you seen that filthy Qiqirn? The one that was shuffling about hither and thither, sniffing everyone's baggage. I have an inkling he might be off getting that oversized nose of his into trouble...
They say the seas around Limsa Lominsa are guarded over by a goddess called the Navigator. If her temper's as bad as this accursed storm, I'd say we're all doomed.
First time in Limsa? Then take this bit of counsel―keep your head down and your blade handy. Talk with Captain Hob if you're looking for a decent place to spend the night.
Step back, [@IF($E9(4),madam,sir)]. All passengers must be inspected prior to being granted entry into the city. Quietly wait your turn or I will be forced to call the Yellowjackets.

Ye say ye saw a powerful sorceress weavin' her magicks 'round the ship, and that it's her what saved us from the serpent's minions? I ain't believin' what I ain't seen with me own two eyes, and I ain't seen no magickal wench, nor no serpent's minions.
But that storm we had─[@1A(1)]that[@1A(0)] be true enough. 'Tweren't fer our fearless Cap'n Hob, we'd all be rottin' at th' bottom o' Rhotano's belly! Don't ye go forgettin' that now, eh?
We're sailors. A little wind or rain won't keep us from findin' our way to port. Bloodthirsty aurelias, on the other hand...well, those we could do without.
Did you see that light? I hope it wasn't what I thought it was...because if it was what I thought it was, we wouldn't be here. Ah, but here is where we are, and all is well, is it not? Heh heh!
Now, my companion, on the other hand...is not here, and that is definitely [@1A(1)]not[@1A(0)] good. Might you have seen her?

Hah hah! My arrival in Limsa Lominsa marks the beginning of a new legend! Call forth the bards, for my adventures will inspire epic tales that shall be sung in the halls of kings and queens across the realm. You, my good [@IF($E9(4),lady,lad)], are a witness to history!
Is there anyone more reliable than a man of the sea? Perhaps I should have stayed on the ship rather than disembarking into this den of wolves.
Last night...I believe we were witness to something well beyond our comprehension, and I believe it is best to leave it at that.

As a merchant, it is never wise to ponder over that which can not earn one a profit...such as that [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000001,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000001,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] you carry. A fine specimen, albeit a tad ripe.
Ah, and our adventure on the seas comes to a close, only to make way for a new one upon the shores of this quaint island.

Perhaps our paths will cross again...and if you are planning on a visit to the Adventurers' Guild, then perhaps they will cross sooner than we think. I hear the good Captain Hob is heading there himself.

Welcome t' Limsa, younglin'. If ye're lookin' for an apology for the rough ride, ye won't find one from me or any o' me crew. Ye're here in one piece, and that's more than ye were guaranteed when ye boarded me ship.

I lost more'n a few good lads to that infernal storm, yet here ye be without so much as a scratch. I'd say ye've someone watchin' over ye...and that ain't no bad thing, 'specially if ye're thinkin' o' seekin' adventure out in the wilds.
I'm bound for the Mizzenmast, where me fill of ale and a soft bed await. Ye can follow me so far if ye please.
Accompany Hob to the Mizzenmast Inn?
Then away we go!
Ain't no need t' be timid, now. I ain't schemin' t' swindle ye none.
Accompany Hob to the Mizzenmast Inn?
Venture above deck?
A strange voice, ye say? Sure it weren't [@1A(1)]sirens[@1A(0)]?
Their song'll tug an' tear at yer very soul, leavin' ye drained of all life, but beggin' fer more. An' them sultry devilets ain't even th' worst o' what's lurkin' in Limsa's waters...
You appear troubled. Might anything be amiss?
Voices? I've heard naught but the infernal squeakings of that damned Qiqirn porter since stepping foot on this vessel.
Count yourself lucky. This is him in a [@1A(1)]good[@1A(0)] mood. Best move along before he turns foul.
Sorry, friend, you're not quite ready for what lies beyond here. Go and show yourself to Momodi at the Quicksand. She'll set you on your way.
An adventurer, is it? Beggar of the realm, more like. Sod off. Only them as have coin can pass.
I've come to the big city to live the Ul'dahn dream, I have. Got a mind to send me ma back home a small fortune.
A piece of advice, dear, as I can see you are not from around here.
Do try not to appear so easy a target. Keep your nose buried in that map of yours too long and the sharks of Ul'dah will have stripped you naked as your nameday before you know it.
Look here, I purchased a platinum ticket. I'm finally going to see Greinfarr the Great on the bloodsands!
Best put any thought of leaving aside for now, friend. Parade's just about underway. That coach of yours was the day's last, in or out.
Sorry, but this area is off limits until the parade is over. They must be planning something [@1A(1)]amazing[@1A(0)]. I'm so excited, I can hardly keep from wetting myself!
But I'm forbidden to leave my post until all is over. Gods grant me the strength of bladder to last that long!
You'll have to excuse me, but I am not taking requests for the nonce.
I happen to be thoroughly enjoying the company of these ravishing young ladies and, gods willing, will still be doing so come sunrise.
Did you see the pretty lights in the sky? They're called fireworks.
I'd never seen them before. They mark the start of festival. Oh, isn't is all so [@1A(1)]wonderful[@1A(0)]!?
Have you ever been to Ul'dah before? No? Neither have I.
A voice? No, I didn't hear anything. All I heard was fireworks. They're pretty, but loud.
You've come just in time for the festivities, friend.
The parade's set to begin shortly. Were I you, I'd go and find myself a decent spot to watch from.
Sorry, friend, off limits. They're still making ready for the parade. Wait just a bit longer.
I heard the parade goes straight down the main road. But where the hells is that? Straight ahead? Back the other way? Bugger me...
Surely you didn't come all this way to watch the festivities alone, love. Perhaps we could enjoy some festivities of our own?

I'd be happy to take your arm, and more, for a time. You deserve a [@1A(1)]proper[@1A(0)] welcome to Ul'dah, [@IF($E9(4),fair lady that you are. I can please you as well as any man,handsome lad that you are)]. Though, from the looks of it, you don't have the coin. A shame, that.
Your timing is near perfect, whether you intended it or not. The parade will begin in mere moments.
They say the main attraction is the giant beast they've brought to fight on the bloodsands of the Coliseum. To hells with that! I've only got eyes for those young lovelies dancing about up top.

That's [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000089,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000089,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] you've got there. Bloody expensive thing. How'd you come by it? Rifled it from a corpse, you say? Hehehe, you're going to be just fine here in Ul'dah, I think.
Now that was quite the sight to behold!
The dancers, [@IF($E9(4),woman,man)], the [@1A(1)]dancers[@1A(0)]! Mine own daughter was among them─and a deal more beautiful than the rest. I'll have the tongue of any who says otherwise.
Ain't no sayin' what'll come to pass in Ul'dah. Aye, any who tells you different is playin' you false.
An' festivals ain't no different. I seen more fistfights an' floggin's than I can count. Hells, even saw an entire family trampled underfoot once.
I've never seen such a fearsome creature! And all those teeth! To think the gladiators of the Coliseum would willingly fight [@1A(1)]that[@1A(0)].

Oh, wipe that blank expression off your face. You really must try to look like less of a bumpkin. I daresay it's not the last rampant beast you'll see in the big city. These things [@1A(1)]do[@1A(0)] happen.
I thought the fireworks explosions at first. I am sure I was not alone─an Ul'dahn festival simply isn't a festival without [@1A(1)]some[@1A(0)] sort of tragedy.
Hahaha, quite a bit of excitement, no? Not like to be a kerfuffle such as that without some fools losing their lives.
They've no need for grief, though. Those who die at festivals are greeted by Nald'thal as friends.
Have you ever been to Ul'dah before? No? Neither have I.
A voice? No, I didn't hear anything. All I heard was fireworks. They're pretty, but loud.
I heard the parade goes straight down the main road. But where the hells is that? Straight ahead? Back the other way? Bugger me...
You heard a voice, eh? Hells, I hear lots of voices. It's called [@1A(1)]people talking[@1A(0)]. Bloody fool...
A piece of advice, dear, as I can see you are not from around here.
Do try not to appear so easy a target. Keep your nose buried in that map of yours too long and the sharks of Ul'dah will have stripped you naked as your nameday before you know it.
A strange voice? Maybe I heard it, and maybe I didn't. Who's asking and what are you offering?
Well, excuse my language then, dear, but bugger off. If there's no gil in it, then there's no [@1A(1)]me[@1A(0)] in it.
